notes: GB storefront (https://www.zarahome.com/gb/) confirmed as a GENUINELY SEPARATE Inditex catalogue from S.N. 21 Zara Home UAE, not a duplicate: store 84009906 / catalog 80290024 (vs UAE's 85009931/50333562), GBP pricing (vs AED). Verified independently: querying the identical global category ID for 'Bedroom Mirrors' (1020241660) against the GB store/catalog returns 12 products vs 8 for the same category ID under UAE's store/catalog -- proving genuinely distinct per-country product population on a shared taxonomy ID scheme, exactly as the brief anticipated. Access route: Akamai Bot Manager JS interstitial solved once per session with pipeline/final_list_batch_sn21-30/inditex_interstitial_solver.py's proof-of-work logic (adapted for en-GB/curl_cffi chrome impersonation), then cookies reused directly against the itxrest category grid API (no per-request re-solve needed) and cross-checked against each PLP's own server-rendered serverApp-state transfer-state productIds array. Every leaf qty is the productIds array length from /itxrest/3/catalog/store/84009906/80290024/category/<id>/product?showProducts=false&showNoStock=false&withSubCategories=false&languageId=-1, independently re-read twice (stable both times) and each canonical SEO URL verified to 200 with a matching page <title>. Cross-checks: Glassware 'See all' (160) = Tumblers (69) + Glasses (51) + Bottles and Jugs (40) exactly, mirroring the same exact-sum pattern the S.N. 21 UAE worker found (Borosilicate is a sibling category, not part of the See-all union, on both storefronts). Zara Home GB renders no 'N items' header anywhere; qty is the exact server-rendered grid tile count per the same method validated on S.N. 21. RULE 0: included Bathroom Lighting (lighting-lamps-bathroom-n5792, qty 2) and Bathroom Mirrors (bathroom-mirrors-n2468, qty 11), which a room-word exclusion would have wrongly dropped, plus Kids Lamps and Lighting (17) and Bedroom Lamps (36), both real decorative-lighting room branches. Home Decor 'Mirrors' landing (n993, category 1089523, 40 products) is treated as the parent grouping node exactly as S.N. 21 did; its six child listings (five general + Bathroom Mirrors) carry the counts. 'Cordless lamps' (category 1020692636, live via the itxrest API with qty 24, appears in the GB mega-menu) is OMITTED -- its own SEO slug (lighting-lamps-cordless-n5192) 404s on the live site, the exact same broken-URL situation the S.N. 21 UAE worker documented for the identical category ID; no working canonical URL exists so it cannot be emitted as a row per the brief's link requirement. 'Hooks' (category 1090528, hooks-n4857, 'Clothing Hooks', qty 18) is a genuinely separate decorative-hooks node from the mega-menu-visible 'Door knobs and hooks' (category 1020447447, door-knobs-handles-n1005, qty 44); product-ID overlap check showed only 15 of Hooks' 18 products inside Door-knobs-and-hooks' 44, confirming the latter is a mixed hardware/decor rollup -- kept Hooks (decorative), dropped Door-knobs-and-hooks (door handles = hardware, per the same exclusion S.N. 21 applied). Excluded per brief: Fragrances (reed diffusers, scented candles, air fresheners, incense, car fresheners, soaps/creams), Rugs, Curtains and Roller Blinds, Cushions, Blankets and Throws, Bedding/Bed Linen (all textiles), Furniture of every kind (armchairs, tables, storage, shelving, sideboards, headboards, bed frames, bathroom furniture), Boxes and Jewellery Boxes (storage/gift boxes, not decor), Baskets (storage), Cutlery, Table Linen (tablecloths/napkins/placemats/runners -- textile), Small Household Appliances, Cooking Utensils, Kitchenware/Cookware, Kitchen Accessories, Cutting Boards, Kitchen Textiles, Kitchen Storage, Cocktail Tools, Barbecue, Picnic (all functional kitchen), Bathroom Towels/Bath Mats/Bathrobes/Laundry Baskets/Towel Racks (textiles/storage/hardware), Bathroom Accessories subtree (bins, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders, soap dishes, trays, cosmetic storage -- all functional bathroom hardware, not decorative), Kids Bedding/Rugs/Curtains/Door knobs/Toys/Clothing/Tableware (cutlery-mixed, per the same precedent S.N. 21 applied to AE), Clothing and Footwear, Pets, Lifestyle Books/Games/Music. Zara Home GB lists no clocks category and no artificial-plants category (confirmed by text search of the full mega-menu), matching S.N. 21's finding for AE. All 36 leaf qtys read stable across two independent passes taken several minutes apart (no drift observed).
